author: reek
body: Seeded procedural name generator for world-building. Every name derives deterministically from an Integer seed, so the same seed always yields the same world -- the "key frames" of a setting stay certain while everything around them can be regenerated. Pure: compiles to bare-metal and to JS (via the html plug), so the same names appear server-side and in the browser.

author: reek
body: forge-<kind> seed -> Text for people, settlements, kingdoms, regions, and natural features. forge-setting seed -> Setting builds a coherent named world (kingdom, capital, ruler, regions, villages, forests, seas, items, quests).

author: reek
body: A multiplicative hash mixes seed + salt; pmod folds it (any sign) into a valid index. Different salts pull independent components from the same seed.

author: reek
body: A coherent named world from one seed. Sub-seeds are offset so each entity is independent, but the whole setting is reproducible from the root seed.
